mapper.insert: INSERT INTO the_full_order.tb_supplier_site_product_offer (supplier_site_id,supplier_product_id,delivery_type,lead_time_days,cutoff_code,cutoff_time, minimum_order_qty,order_increment_qty,decimal_order_allowed,product_status,status_reason,valid_from,valid_to, provider_revision,provider_attributes,active_yn,last_synced_at) VALUES (#{supplier_site_id},#{supplier_product_id},#{delivery_type},COALESCE(#{lead_time_days},0),#{cutoff_code},#{cutoff_time}, #{minimum_order_qty},#{order_increment_qty},COALESCE(#{decimal_order_allowed},'N'),COALESCE(#{product_status},'ACTIVE'), #{status_reason},#{valid_from},#{valid_to},#{provider_revision},#{provider_attributes},COALESCE(#{active_yn},'Y'),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE delivery_type=VALUES(delivery_type),lead_time_days=VALUES(lead_time_days),cutoff_code=VALUES(cutoff_code), cutoff_time=VALUES(cutoff_time),minimum_order_qty=VALUES(minimum_order_qty),order_increment_qty=VALUES(order_increment_qty), decimal_order_allowed=VALUES(decimal_order_allowed),product_status=VALUES(product_status),status_reason=VALUES(status_reason), valid_from=VALUES(valid_from),valid_to=VALUES(valid_to),provider_revision=VALUES(provider_revision), provider_attributes=VALUES(provider_attributes),active_yn=VALUES(active_yn),last_synced_at=NOW(), supplier_offer_id=LAST_INSERT_ID(supplier_offer_id)

base_unit=IF(base_qty<=0,VALUES(base_unit),base_unit), package_unit=IF(base_qty<=0,VALUES(package_unit),package_unit), package_qty=IF(base_qty<=0,VALUES(package_qty),package_qty), base_qty=IF(base_qty<=0,VALUES(base_qty),base_qty), alt_base_qty=VALUES(alt_base_qty),alt_base_unit=VALUES(alt_base_unit), product_name=VALUES(product_name),minimum_order_qty=VALUES(minimum_order_qty), image_url=IF(#{images_provided},VALUES(image_url),image_url), thumbnail_url=IF(#{images_provided},VALUES(thumbnail_url),thumbnail_url), order_multiple_qty=VALUES(order_multiple_qty),tax_type=VALUES(tax_type),active_yn=VALUES(active_yn),user_id=VALUES(user_id)

mapper.update: UPDATE the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p SET base_qty=#{base_qty},base_unit=#{base_unit},package_qty=#{package_qty},package_unit=#{package_unit} WHERE p.supplier_product_id=#{supplier_product_id} AND #{base_qty}>0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order_item i WHERE i.supplier_product_id=p.supplier_product_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM the_full_order.tb_account_inventory_lot l WHERE l.supplier_product_id=p.supplier_product_id)

mapper.select: SELECT po.purchase_order_id,po.supplier_id,ss.supplier_account_site_id, poi.purchase_order_item_id,NULLIF(poi.source_ingredient_id,'') ingredient_id,poi.order_qty, poi.received_order_qty,poi.base_qty_per_order_unit,poi.base_unit,poi.unit_price_snapshot, p.supplier_product_id,COALESCE(poi.product_name_snapshot,p.product_name) product_name FROM the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order po JOIN the_full_order.tb_account_purchase_order_item poi ON poi.purchase_order_id=po.purchase_order_id JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_ingredient_product p ON p.supplier_product_id=poi.supplier_product_id LEFT JOIN the_full_order.tb_supplier_account_site ss ON ss.account_id=po.account_id AND ss.supplier_id=po.supplier_id AND ss.external_site_code=po.sold_to WHERE po.account_id=#{account_id} AND po.client_ord=#{client_ord} AND po.sold_to=#{sold_to} AND p.supplier_id=po.supplier_id AND poi.client_ord_item=#{client_ord_item} AND p.supplier_item_code=#{supplier_item_code} LIMIT 1
